title: GTA 6 first 48 hours checklist
intro: Everything worth doing in your first two days, in a sensible order. Tick things off as you go. Items tagged unconfirmed will be checked against the released game.

items.text: Pick your display mode (performance or quality) before you start
Turn down motion blur and camera shake if they bother you
Turn on subtitles so you don't miss mission instructions in loud scenes
Claim any pre-order or edition bonuses before your first save
Play through the opening missions until the map opens up
Find your first safehouse and save there
Open the phone and check which apps and contacts you already have
Find the nearest weapon and clothing shops
Pick a car worth keeping and learn how to store it
Try one early money method and see if it fits how you play
Learn when you can switch between Lucia and Jason
Find your first collectible so you know what to look for
Try one side activity that pays
Drive to every region once to reveal the map
Spend your first real money on the upgrade that helps most
Check whether any property or business is worth buying early
Hunt one secret or easter egg from the map
